integrity: The proof is self-contained and analytic for every finite bipartition and every Hilbert space; the embedded checker tests finite instances only. There is no claim of external verification.
limitations: The amplified best constants, arbitrary weighted or normalized-degree graphs, and other spatial exponents remain outside the theorem. Older unindexed equivalent calculations are possible.
title: The exact \(L^4\) heat square-function contraction boundary on complete bipartite graphs
